title.narrative: Towards a more circular Uruguay (Uruguay + Circular)

description.narrative: In addition to the Global Environmental Benefits (GEBs) the project is expected to deliver on the following socio-economic benefits: - Reduce air pollution / reduce waste and wastewater pollution by reducing contaminants and increasing circularity in targeted sectors. The project will remove or dispose 50 metric tonnes of POPs removed or disposed, reduce 6,149 of plastic waste, avoid 1,089,000 metric tons of CO2e and reduce 5.8 gTEQ of UPOPs during its implementation. - Enhance participation, equality, and inclusion (including for women, youths, and Indigenous Peoples and local communities) by ensuring proper engagement and equal access to identified vulnerable groups. Based on the beneficiaries’ estimations, the project will properly engage at least 7,130 women and 500 classifiers during its implementation. - Improve education, skills, capacity and technology for sustainable development, through several interventions targeting different stakeholders’ groups to reduce identified contaminants through chemicals and waste integrated management towards a circular economy. Based on the different activities/interventions to be implemented through the project capacity building and training will target 14,595 people (7,130 women and 7,345 men) from different stakeholders’ groups (government officers, private sectors, students, financial institutions) - Create job opportunities enhanced through the deployment of business models to circularity of targeted sectors. Through the activities aiming at providing technical assistance to MSMEs and classifiers it is estimated that at least 250 jobs opportunities will be enhanced during project implementation related to demonstration activities and the strengthening of the public Inventory of initiatives for the socio-productive inclusion of waste pickers. These co-benefits will be monitored and reported on during project implementation (at MTR and TE).
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.
Reducing pollutant emissions and releases (GHG, UPOPs) through chemicals and waste integrated management towards a circular economy in Uruguay.
